subject.title: [Bug]: Embedded runner "Network connection lost" when LLM generates a tool call with large parameters (param generation latency > underlying request timeout)

question: Should OpenClaw solve OpenRouter-routed Anthropic large tool-argument stalls by changing default timeout policy, adding OpenRouter-specific Anthropic tool streaming support, or changing large-output tool strategy?
rationale: Each viable fix changes provider/runtime behavior with compatibility and operator-impact tradeoffs, and source inspection alone does not prove which policy is intended for OpenRouter's proxy path.

options.title: Live repro then narrow provider fix
options.body: Reproduce the OpenRouter/Anthropic large `Write` path, then implement the smallest provider/runtime change that preserves existing configured timeout behavior.

options.title: Document timeout mitigation only
options.body: Keep runtime behavior unchanged and document `models.providers.openrouter.timeoutSeconds` as the supported workaround for slow large tool calls.

options.title: Defer to broader timeout cluster
options.body: Close this only if maintainers decide the broader OpenRouter/Telegram reliability tracker should own all OpenRouter long-request timeout work.

recommendation.title: Live repro then narrow provider fix
recommendation.body: Reproduce the OpenRouter/Anthropic large `Write` path, then implement the smallest provider/runtime change that preserves existing configured timeout behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest local history signal is recent ownership of the OpenRouter model-construction and embedded runner timeout paths that would need the policy choice.
